files.README.md:
# Ulshaw Mills - drive firmware

Firmware releases for the mill drives are logged in `releases/release-log.csv`, one row per release, oldest first. The summary column says what each release changed. A capability that no summary mentions has never shipped in a drive release.

Field engineers' checklists are kept under `docs/`.
files.releases/release-log.csv:
version,release_date,summary

1.9.4,2026-01-20,Added SNMPv1 read-only monitoring for the plant room
2.3.1,2026-04-08,Smoother ramp-down on stop; web dashboard charts
2.7.0,2026-06-30,Added load balancing across twin drive cabinets
3.0.2,2026-09-02,Protocol tidy-up ahead of the cabin controller launch
files.docs/engineer-checklist.md:
# Field engineer checklist

On every visit: read the fault log, check belt tension, and confirm the cabinet fan is clear. Where a site has SNMP figures enabled they are read off the plant room panel.

turns.prompt: An Ulshaw Mills customer runs twin drive cabinets and needs the arrival version of the feature they depend on for the maintenance contract paperwork. Which release version first added load balancing across twin drive cabinets?
